From: Bhatia, Peter <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Sent: Thursday, September 10, 2020 11:46 PM
To: DFP_Everybody <DFP_Everybody@freepress.com>
Subject: Fwd: Truth-telling

From: "Graham, Janet" <jlgraham@freepress.com>
Date: September 10, 2020 at 11:40:35 PM EDT
To: "Bhatia, Peter" <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Subject: RE:  Truth-telling

Jonathan Lemire of AP just gave the Detroit Free Press a huge shout-out on Brian Williams’ show on MSNBC.  Williams pointed out that the Free Press fact-checked Trump immediately on the auto plants and Lemire said, that’s a huge credit to the Free Press for having the expertise to do that so quickly and it’s so important, the local coverage of these election events.

From: Bhatia, Peter 
Sent: Thursday, September 10, 2020 11:38 PM
To: DFP_Everybody <DFP_Everybody@freepress.com>
Subject: FW: Truth-telling
Editor and Vice President, Detroit Free Press and freep.com
Michigan regional editor, USA TODAY Network

From: "Bhatia, Peter" <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Date: Thursday, September 10, 2020 at 11:08 PM
To: DFP_Management <DFP_Management@freepress.com>
Cc: "Boucher, Dave" <dboucher@freepress.com>, Todd Spangler <tspangler@freepress.com>, "Nash, Amalie" <anash@gannett.com>
Subject: Truth-telling

Very much appreciate the structure of this story. The national press could learn from it. We are in the business of telling the truth and that’s what Todd and Dave did here. Facts first, rhetoric later. This is what we owe our readers.
Editor and Vice President, Detroit Free Press and freep.com
Michigan regional editor, USA TODAY Network
